title: alternative protections
description: a datapack which changes how the different protection enchants work (besides regular protection)
body:
affectted enchants:
-fire protection - now immune to fire & 100% burn reduction
-blast protection - now immune to explosions & 100& explosion knockback resistence
-projectile protection - now immune to projectiles
-feather falling - now immune to fall damage
-respiration - now immune to drowing
